claim: Prominent US Democrat party members including Hillary and Bill Clinton, were running a child sex-trafficking ring in the basement of a Washington, D.C., pizzeria.

sub_claims.question: Is there any credible evidence or official confirmation that Hillary Clinton and Bill Clinton were involved in running a child sex-trafficking ring?
sub_claims.answer: No, there is no credible evidence or official confirmation linking Hillary Clinton or Bill Clinton to child sex-trafficking; this claim is part of the debunked Pizzagate conspiracy theory.

evidence.statement: In December 2016, the Washington, D.C., Metropolitan Police Department investigated allegations related to Comet Ping Pong and issued a statement finding no evidence linking Hillary Clinton or Bill Clinton to child sex-trafficking.

sub_claims.question: Was there a pizzeria in Washington, D.C., implicated in allegations of child sex-trafficking?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, Comet Ping Pong in Washington, D.C., was targeted by the Pizzagate conspiracy theory, but investigations found no evidence of illegal activities.

evidence.statement: Comet Ping Pong, a pizzeria located at 5037 Connecticut Avenue NW in Washington, D.C., was falsely implicated in the Pizzagate conspiracy theory in 2016.
The Washington, D.C., Metropolitan Police Department conducted an investigation in December 2016 and concluded that there was no evidence of illegal activities at Comet Ping Pong.

sub_claims.question: Did law enforcement or investigations find evidence of a child sex-trafficking ring in the basement of a Washington, D.C., pizzeria?
sub_claims.answer: No, law enforcement and fact-checkers have thoroughly debunked the claim, finding no basement or trafficking ring in the pizzeria.

evidence.statement: James Alefantis, the owner of Comet Ping Pong, confirmed in interviews that the restaurant has no basement, contradicting the conspiracy theory.
Fact-checking organizations such as Snopes verified in 2016 that law enforcement found no basement or child sex-trafficking ring at Comet Ping Pong.
